question_summary: Request approval to substitute PEX for the specified copper domestic water piping in Section 22 11 16 prior to ordering material.
proposed_solution: Use PEX piping in lieu of specified copper for domestic water; no change to fixture budget or pressure test date.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: As a Division 22 material substitution for domestic water piping, it requires technical approval by the Plumbing Engineer of Record.
